brief: Big two-and-a-half-storey front-gabled ranch house in chocolate-brown painted clapboard with crisp white trim: a broad front gable with a banded cornice return and a four-light attic window under a little shelf roof, cross gables on both sides and a tall red brick chimney up the south wall. A shed-roofed front porch on plain white columns runs across the ground floor with leaded-glass sidelights at the door; windows are multi-pane upper sashes over one. A one-storey gable-roofed garage wing in matching brown hangs off the rear corner. The house sits alone on a bare grassy knoll with foundation shrubs and the paint peeling on the weather side.
